data.text: Major freshwater flooding has begun in Cebu City as the extremely heavy rain core of Typhoon Kalmaegi (TinoPH) moves over the island of Cebu in the Philippines. This is Kalmaegi’s second landfall across the Pacific archipelago since his initial landing in Leyte at Category 2 strength earlier today. The footage below confirms a very life-threatening situation that is ongoing for Cebu City, with cars and vehicles fully floating down deeply flooded streets. Unfortunately, rain from Kalmaegi will continue for a few more hours in this location.

Severe flooding struck Villa del Rio 1 in Bacayan, Cebu City, with rising waters sweeping away vehicles due to relentless rains from Typhoon, while floodwaters hit Villa Azalea, Cotcot, Liloan, forcing residents onto rooftops. #TinoPH

Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino) is bringing life-threatening conditions and destructive storm surges to central Philippines, prompting widespread evacuations and heavy damage across the Visayas, including Cebu City and surrounding areas.
